samples.description: A complete demo game that shows the full workflow of resource update, resource download and resource loading.
File system implementations for mini game platforms, including Wechat, Tiktok, Alipay, Taptap, Oppo, Vivo, KuaiShou and Google Play.
Runtime and editor extension examples, including asset reference, bundle encryption, custom operation, sprite atlas loader, shader variant collector and package tools.
UniTask integration example, please read the README documentation in the sample.
Unit test cases, including asset loading, encryption and file system tests.
